l4Discriminating.text: Exogenous algorithmic or synthetic data generation parameter step — The readings may not originate from physical laboratory apparatus within Meridian, but from an underlying computational generator or synthetic data stream. Under this interpretation, an uncoupled step change in the generator's distribution parameters for pendulum_obs was enacted around Day 15. This neatly accounts for why the shift occurred strictly in pendulum_obs without mechanical or acoustic coupling to resonator_obs (drift z = -1.08), as well as unexplained mathematical cross-checks in the notebook such as the 3-day lagged correlation between pendulum_lab and resonator_obs (r = 0.473 vs chance ±0.282).
